name: fmea-paper
title: Draft FMEA working paper
for_each: select id,code from analyses order by code

sections.title: Failure chains
sections.sql: select code,process_step,function_text,mode,effect,cause from failures where analysis_id=$1 order by code

sections.title: Ratings and review
sections.note: Recorded priorities require engineering review. No certification or process release.
sections.sql: select code,severity,occurrence,detection_rating,rpn,action_priority,priority_basis,revision,reviewed from failure_register where analysis_id=$1 order by code

name: control-plan
title: Draft control plan and action register
for_each: select id,code from analyses order by code

sections.title: Control plan
sections.sql: select c.code,f.code failure,c.characteristic,c.method,c.frequency,c.reaction,c.owner,c.failure_revision,f.revision current_revision from controls c join failures f on f.id=c.failure_id where f.analysis_id=$1 order by c.code

sections.title: Actions
sections.sql: select ac.code,f.code failure,ac.description,ac.owner,ac.due,ac.status,ac.completion_evidence,ac.verification_evidence from actions ac join failures f on f.id=ac.failure_id where f.analysis_id=$1 order by ac.due,ac.code
